title: How to use a project milestone tracker on Mac: guide for project coordinators
metaTitle: Project Milestone Tracker for Mac: A Guide for Project Coordinators
description: Master your project milestone tracker on your Mac. Learn to manage timelines, communication, and documentation with Lazur's voice-first assistant.
intro: As a project coordinator, you know that keeping a project milestone tracker accurate is the difference between a successful delivery and a missed deadline. You spend your day bridging gaps between teams, updating documentation, and chasing status updates across multiple apps. Lazur helps you manage this load by acting as your voice-first assistant on your Mac. Hold a key, ask a question, and get back to the work that matters.
tldr: Project coordinators spend up to 40 percent of their time on administrative tasks like updating project boards.
Email and chat take up significant portions of your day, often leading to fragmented information.
Lazur lives in your Mac notch to help you track milestones, draft emails, and find information in seconds.
You can use Lazur to guide you through complex software interfaces without clicking through endless menus.

blocks.text: Why your project milestone tracker feels like a burden

You are the information hub for your team. Every project milestone tracker you use requires constant manual input. You move data from a Slack message to a Jira ticket. You copy a date from an email into a Notion database. This is work about work. It consumes your time and leaves less space for actual project strategy.
Managing your Mac workspace with voice commands

Your Mac is your primary tool. You likely have Slack, Notion, and your email client open all day. Lazur sits in your Mac notch, ready to help. When you need to find a specific milestone or check a status, you do not need to hunt for the right tab. You hold ⌥ ⌘, talk to Lazur, and get an answer.

items: Updating milestones only at the end of the day.
Relying on memory instead of documenting decisions in real time.
Switching between too many apps to find a single piece of information.
Ignoring the impact of communication overhead on your project timeline.

blocks.text: How to stay organized with Lazur

Lazur helps you stay in the flow. If you are in Notion and need to add a new project milestone, ask Lazur to guide you. It will point at the correct button to create a new row or database entry. If you are drafting a status update in Slack, use the dictation feature by holding the fn key to write clean, formatted text quickly.

If you handle sensitive project data, always check your employer guidelines on using AI tools. Lazur does not store your screen or audio data, but your workplace security policy is the final authority.
blocks.title: Data Privacy Note

blocks.text: Whether you use Jira, Asana, or a custom Notion workspace, the challenge is the same. You need to keep the data fresh. Use Lazur to ask where a specific setting is. You can say, 'Where is the timeline view in this project board?' and Lazur will draw a circle around the menu item. This saves you from clicking through every dropdown menu.
The daily routine of a project coordinator

Your day is fragmented. You start by triaging messages. You move to meetings. You finish by updating your project milestone tracker. This cycle repeats daily. Lazur helps you transition between these states by keeping your focus on the screen and your hands on the keyboard.

faq.question: Can Lazur update my project milestone tracker for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It guides you to the right place on your screen so you can perform the update yourself.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with every project management app?
faq.answer: Lazur works on your Mac screen. If you can see the app, Lazur can help you navigate it by pointing at buttons or answering questions about the interface.
